overview_description.description: FlowiseAI is an open-source platform for building AI agents and workflows. It allows the creation of multi-agent systems with workflow orchestration across different agents. It also supports single-agent systems such as chatbots with tool calling and knowledge retrieval from multiple data sources. The platform provides execution traces and connects with observability tools like Prometheus and OpenTelemetry. Developers can integrate Flowise into applications using APIs, SDKs, or embedded chat widgets. The service supports deployment at production scale with options for cloud and on-premises environments.
